scientific_integrity: The new result is the all-lag covariance distribution and its measure decomposition, not previously established one-window or adjacent-window densities.
scientific_limitations: No rates of convergence in either the starting-index or lag averages.
The absolutely continuous density is characterized implicitly but not evaluated in closed form.
The proof relies on a published rational-independence lemma; prior implicit coverage in broader toral-coding literature cannot be excluded.
title: The full lag-covariance law of empty intervals between consecutive powers
